title: US says hackers are targeting vulnerable water systems with the help of AI
summary: The US government warned that hackers are targeting internet-connected Siemens controllers in water facilities across the country, leveraging AI capabilities to exploit vulnerabilities in critical infrastructure. This threat underscores the growing cybersecurity risks facing essential services.
content: Hackers are targeting internet-connected Siemens controllers used in water facilities around the United States.

zh.title: 美国称黑客正在利用AI帮助针对易受攻击的水系统
zh.summary: 美国政府警告称，黑客正在针对全国水设施中的互联网连接Siemens控制器，利用AI能力来利用关键基础设施中的漏洞。这一威胁突显了对基本服务日益增长的网络安全风险。

title: Meta AI’s new Mac app wants you to talk to your apps
summary: Meta released a new Mac app powered by its Muse Spark AI model that enables voice-activated dictation for controlling applications. The tool aims to streamline hands-free interaction with software.
content: Meta said its Muse Spark model is powering the dictation feature.

zh.title: Meta AI的新Mac应用想让你与应用对话

title: Meta glasses are a workplace menace
summary: Ray-Ban Meta glasses are being weaponized by pranksters to film and harass service workers, with customers repeatedly pranking employees at retailers like Target while recording interactions. The incident raises concerns about workplace safety and privacy in an increasingly connected environment.
content:
In August, Toru Hinkle was stocking shelves at their job at Target when they noticed two customers and asked if they needed any help. The men requested a price check on an item - but even after Hinkle told them the item was $20, the customers asked for the price again and again. 
"After a while, I realized that I'm basically being pranked, and I noticed the glasses," Hinkle says, referring to the frames with a blinking light. They were the Ray-Ban Meta glasses, and the customers were filming. zh.title: Meta眼镜成为职场公害

title: Slack is launching collaborative vibe-coding channels
summary: Slack introduced dedicated Code channels where teams can collaborate with AI coding agents like Claude and Devin to build features, fix bugs, and review code changes without switching tools. The new feature aims to streamline development workflows and reduce context switching.
content:
Slack is introducing dedicated channels where teams can vibe-code together with AI agents instead of jumping between different tools and conversations. The Slack Code launch includes open, project-specific code channels with dedicated user tabs, alongside features that compare coding changes and preview HTML output before the project is shipped. 
"With Slack Code, when you have an idea or need to build a new feature, update a web page, or fix a bug, you simply tag in a coding agent like Anthropic's Claude or Cognition's Devin, and that agent then spins up a code channel to tackle the task," Slack said in its press release. zh.title: Slack 推出协作编程频道
zh.summary: Slack 推出了专用的代码频道，团队可以与 Claude 和 Devin 等 AI 编码代理协作，在不切换工具的情况下构建功能、修复错误和审查代码更改。这项新功能旨在简化开发工作流并减少上下文切换。

title: I ruined my cats’ toilet time with a motion-activated neon litter box sign
summary: A tech writer installed a motion-activated neon "On Air" sign above their cat's litter box as an experimental prank that inadvertently disrupted the cat's bathroom routine. The humorous home automation mishap became an ongoing family joke.
content:
My two cats live a refreshingly low-tech lifestyle. They've never experienced a robot litter box, an automated feeder, or a GPS tracker. Noodle and Loaf live blissfully unaware of the technological trappings that surround the rest of my life. 
Except, that is, for the glowing neon sign that turns on whenever they go to the toilet.
I can't, and won't, take responsibility for the "On Air" sign. It was my partner's idea, suggested - I thought - as a joke. That was until it turned up at the house and I realized she was all too sincere.

title: The piano that taught my cat to play for her supper
summary: A cat learned to play a piano keyboard that dispenses treats when activated, now using it to express musical frustration and disrupt the owner's sleep when disturbed. The piano demonstrates how pets adapt to unexpected tech in unexpected ways.
content:
The artist, in a moment of quiet contemplation. | Photo by Elizabeth Lopatto / The Verge	

The pianist sits before her instrument. She carefully extends a front paw, pressing gingerly on a key. She presses again, and again. She is composing some soul music, because something terrible has happened to her: The vacuum cleaner has come out of the closet.
Yes, my cat is a tortured artist. When Jeeves is moved by something that upsets her - say, I have gotten up when she was comfortable sitting in my lap - she goes to her piano and plays a brief melody. title: The Audi S6 Sportback E-tron proves that sedans still matter
summary: The 2027 Audi S6 Sportback E-tron proves that electric sedans can deliver compelling performance and design, maintaining Audi's tradition of fast sedans while transitioning to all-electric propulsion. The car demonstrates that sedans remain relevant despite the industry's shift toward SUVs.
content:
Last year, Audi announced that it gave its all-EV-by-2033 plan the boot, and instead will offer a mix of gasoline, hybrid, and electrified propulsion. There's no doubt still some uncertainty among bigger automakers - especially those under the Volkswagen Group umbrella - when it comes to such a (now prior) commitment. Even so, what it's currently offering on the EV front is rather good, and fits into the German brand's under-the-radar fast sedan tradition quite well.
I recently discovered this in the 2027 Audi S6 Sportback E-tron. A cross between a sedan and a wagon in terms of its rearward shape, there's no hulking Quattro all-wheel drive  …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 奥迪 S6 Sportback E-tron 证明轿车仍然重要
zh.summary: 2027年奥迪 S6 Sportback E-tron 证明电动轿车能够提供强劲的性能和设计，在向全电动推进过渡的同时保持了奥迪快速轿车的传统。尽管行业转向 SUV，该车证明了轿车仍然具有相关性。

title: Sennheiser’s new Momentum 5 earbuds feature easily replaceable batteries
summary: Sennheiser's new Momentum True Wireless 5 earbuds feature user-replaceable batteries accessible with a screwdriver, extending product lifespan and reducing electronic waste. The earbuds launch September 3rd at $299.95.
content:
Sennheiser announced the next version of its flagship wireless earbuds with a major redesign focusing on sustainability. The company claims the new design improves the Momentum True Wireless 5's "comfort, stability, and portability," but a more compelling reason to upgrade is that you won't have to replace them in a few years when they stop holding a charge. Both the Momentum 5 earbuds and their charging case feature user-replaceable batteries that are accessible using a compact screwdriver instead of having to hack through layers of glue.

zh.title: 森海塞尔新款 Momentum 5 耳塞具有易于更换的电池
zh.summary: 森海塞尔新款 Momentum True Wireless 5 耳塞配备用户可更换的电池，可用螺丝刀取出，延长产品使用寿命并减少电子垃圾。耳塞将于9月3日以 $299.95 的价格上市。

title: Binance now lets AI agents trade, but keeping them in check is largely up to users
summary: Binance introduced Agent OS, enabling AI agents including Claude Code and ChatGPT to execute trades on its platform, shifting oversight responsibility to users. The move marks a significant step toward AI-driven autonomous trading.
content: Binance's Agent OS works with tools including ChatGPT, Claude Code, and Cursor.

zh.summary: 币安推出了 Agent OS，使包括 Claude Code 和 ChatGPT 在内的 AI 代理能够在其平台上执行交易，将监督责任转移给用户。此举标志着向 AI 驱动的自主交易迈出了重要一步。

title: LG’s new OLED breakthrough can boost display lifespans
summary: LG Display unveiled FLiPP, a new OLED manufacturing process that eliminates fine metal masks to produce brighter, longer-lasting, and more efficient panels. The breakthrough could transform OLED production and enable flexible displays of nearly any size.
content:
LG Display unveiled the new FLiPP panel process at IMID 2026 on August 19th. | Image: LG Display	

LG Display has unveiled a new OLED manufacturing method that reportedly results in panels that are brighter, longer-lasting, more efficient, and theoretically can be almost any size. This new technology is called FLiPP (FMM-Less innovative Pixel Patterning), which LG Display describes as a "dream next-generation OLED" patterning method that aims to eliminate some of the existing limitations in OLED panels.

The main advantage of FLiPP is that it doesn't use a fine metal mask (FMM) like conventional RGB OLEDs, which is a metal plate with tiny holes used to stencil light-emitting materials for pixel patterning. This manufacturing process can b …

zh.title: LG新OLED突破可延长显示屏寿命
zh.summary: LG Display推出了FLiPP,这是一种新的OLED制造工艺,消除了精细金属掩膜,可以生产更亮、更耐用且更高效的面板。这一突破可能会改变OLED生产,并使几乎任何尺寸的柔性显示屏成为可能。

content: Without a rescue, NASA's Swift Observatory is expected to reenter the atmosphere later this year.
